# Stocks: Flat Files API Reference

4 Flat Files endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Day Aggregates

`S3 /stocks/day-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/stocks/day-aggregates.md)

Candlesticks with open, high, low, close, and volume at per-day granularity across all U.S. equities, made available as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker transactions volume window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter 5y · Developer 10y · Advanced all

### Minute Aggregates

`S3 /stocks/minute-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/stocks/minute-aggregates.md)

Candlesticks with open, high, low, close, and volume at per minute granularity across all U.S. equities, made available as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker transactions volume window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter 5y · Developer 10y · Advanced all

### Quotes

`S3 /stocks/quotes` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/stocks/quotes.md)

Top of book quotes with nanosecond timestamps from all major U.S. exchanges and darkpools, including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, Finra, and more, made available as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `ask_exchange ask_price ask_size bid_exchange bid_price bid_size conditions indicators participant_timestamp sequence_number sip_timestamp tape ticker trf_timestamp`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced EOD · history Advanced all

### Trades

`S3 /stocks/trades` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/stocks/trades.md)

Tick level nanosecond timestamped trade data from all major U.S. exchanges and darkpools including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, Finra, and more, made available as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `conditions correction exchange id participant_timestamp price sequence_number sip_timestamp size tape ticker trf_id trf_timestamp`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer–Advanced EOD · history Developer 10y · Advanced all
